title: Reusable asynchronous scoring service infrastructure
description: Provide a reusable, client-neutral AWS infrastructure surface for deploying the complete asynchronous scoring service substrate. Definition of done: network, scoring, integration hosting, scheduled worker hosting, operations, artifact repository, and observability stacks are configurable; consumers supply behavior and configuration; existing legacy deployments remain untouched; immutable score-processor artifacts are deployed exactly as validated.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementation started. The migration will use reusable Stack subclasses with consumer-supplied configuration, preserve existing construct identifiers for adopters, keep all runtime behavior outside Plexus, and reject mutable score-processor image resolution. Legacy infrastructure entry points are out of scope and must remain unchanged.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Reusable stack implementations are complete for networking, operations, asynchronous scoring, authenticated integration hosting, container repositories, scheduled workers, and monitoring. Consumer-specific names, handlers, routes, environment variables, and worker definitions are supplied through constructor properties. The asynchronous scoring stack now accepts only an explicit digest URI or a required CloudFormation parameter with a sha256 pattern. Validation: python -m flake8 plexus/infrastructure/scoring_service infrastructure/tests/unit/test_scoring_service_platform_stacks.py; python -m pytest infrastructure/tests/unit -q.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
